source: AliExpress item 3256811965834478, seller dimension drawing (7-pin version), read 2026-11-23. The user's own module is NOT yet confirmed to be this version (some have 8 pins with a backlight pin). 2026-11-24: the user's board matches (7 pins, tab, no header); the ribbon fold was added from their test print.
datum: display centre on the PCB FRONT face (the face the screen sits on); +Z out of the screen toward the viewer; +Y toward the pin-header tab

pcb_len: overall PCB length including the header tab (tab end is 26.5 from the display centre)
tft_t: screen (glass + backlight) thickness in front of the PCB, +/-0.1
smd_h: tallest component on the back of the PCB
bl_h: backlight / glass outline height (longer toward the tab), +/-0.1
hole_pitch: two mounting holes on the tab, centre to centre
hole_from_tab_end: mounting hole centres above the tab end (dimension line read from the drawing)
pin_pitch: 7 pins: RST CS DC SDA SCL GND VCC
pin_row_from_tab_end: pin row above the tab end
header_behind_pcb: straight pin header standing behind the PCB if fitted (11.3 overall - PCB - screen); unknown whether the user's is soldered on
fpc_w: flex ribbon width at the tab side of the screen, centred (user, first test print, 'around 14')
fpc_past_screen: the ribbon's fold reaches this far past the screen outline toward the pins, as thick as the screen (user, 'about 2')
solder_leg_front: how far the soldered wire ends / solder stand proud of the board's FRONT face at the 7 pads (user 2026-11-24: they tilt the display; height not measured)

note: Held in the pod by a pocket in front and the cover's tongue behind: the two 2 mm holes are not used (no M2 screws on hand).
